citations.title: 저작자표시-비영리-변경금지 2.0 대한민국 이용자는 아래의 조건을 따르는 경우에 한하여 자유롭게

reception: In the citing record the paper serves as the gateway to the language itself: much of its reception comes from work that programs in Halide rather than merely discussing it. Camera pipelines including burst photography for high dynamic range imaging on mobile cameras and Fast Fourier Color Constancy were written in the language; Mullapudi and colleagues automated Halide scheduling; later work made Halide pipelines differentiable, translated existing image processing libraries into Halide, and retargeted the compiler to heterogeneous hardware and FPGAs through systems such as HeteroHalide. Around these users sits a broad periphery that cites the paper as the representative image-processing DSL when framing new compilers and languages. The compiler and its community live on at halide/Halide.
